function literal<T extends true>(value: T extends true ? { id: number } : null) {
  return value.id;
}
function bounded<T extends string>(value: T extends unknown ? { id: number } : null) {
  return value.id;
}
function disjoint<T extends number>(value: T extends string ? null : { id: number }) {
  return value.id;
}
function structural<T extends { ready: true }>(value: T extends { ready: boolean } ? { id: number } : null) {
  return value.id;
}
type Words<T> = T extends string ? T[] : null;
function capitals<T extends string>(value: Words<T>) {
  return value.map((item) => item.toUpperCase()).join(",");
}
console.log(literal<true>({ id: 1 }), bounded<string>({ id: 2 }));
console.log(disjoint<number>({ id: 3 }), structural<{ ready: true }>({ id: 4 }), capitals<string>(["word"]));
function explicitUnknown<T extends unknown>(value: T extends unknown ? { id: number } : null) {
  return value.id;
}
function explicitAny<T extends any>(value: T extends any ? { id: number } : undefined) {
  return value.id;
}
type NonEmpty<T> = T extends never ? undefined : T;
function nonEmpty<T extends { id: number }>(value: NonEmpty<T>) {
  return value.id;
}
function excludesNever<T extends string>(value: T extends never ? null : { id: number }) {
  return value.id;
}
function anyNever<T extends any>(value: T extends never ? null : { id: number }) {
  return value.id;
}
console.log(explicitUnknown<string>({ id: 5 }), explicitAny<number>({ id: 6 }), nonEmpty({ id: 7 }));
console.log(excludesNever<string>({ id: 8 }), anyNever<number>({ id: 9 }));
